info.title: Reporting platform API
info.summary: The HTTP API of the reporting platform under /api/reporting/v1, and the production server's health and readiness.
info.description:
Written from the handlers in transport/httpapi and server/http.go; docs/API.md is the prose reference and wins where they differ, which TestOpenAPIMatchesTheBoundRoutes (transport/httpapi/openapi_test.go) and TestOpenAPIMatchesTheHealthRoutes (server/openapi_test.go) keep from happening for the routes themselves. `x-reporting-mount` names the handler that binds an operation: `core` is httpapi.Handler, `layouts` its optional layout store, the others the With* mounts, `server` the production server only. A deployment serves only the mounts it composes; a route it does not compose is 404.

Every answer carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` (or a policy of the route's own that includes it) and exactly one `X-Reporting-Data-Class` (`contract-simulator`, or `business-data` on a production server that allows no simulator). JSON answers are `application/json; charset=utf-8`. An unknown path or method is the Go mux's plain-text 404 or 405.

servers.description: The API listener: the console, the API under /api/reporting/v1 and, on the production server, /healthz and /readyz.

tags.description: Owner-private report layouts; mounted when a layout directory is configured.

tags.name: samples
tags.description: The embedded sample pack (S06-B), mounted with the templates. `/document-templates/samples/{kind}` and `/document-templates/{id}/...` overlap as templates; they do not as requests: a template id is 32 hexadecimal digits, never `samples`, and every path under `/document-templates/samples` goes to the sample pack.

tags.name: sign-in
tags.description: The console's browser sign-in (S15-A, ADR 0019): OpenID Connect authorization code with PKCE, the code exchanged by the server. Unauthenticated. GET /sign-in is the core API's ({"enabled": false}) unless WithSignIn answers it; POST /sign-in/token is WithSignIn's alone.

tags.name: schedules
tags.description: Scheduled reports and their runs (S16-A, WithSchedules): mounted when the deployment configures `schedules`.

tags.name: administration
tags.description: The administrator's read-only view of the configuration in force (S18-B).

get.summary: Liveness
get.description: No authentication and no dependency touched; not served by the demo.

get.summary: Readiness
get.description: No authentication; not served by the demo. The object store's last answer is cached for 10 seconds.

get.summary: How the console starts a browser sign-in
get.description: Unauthenticated and never cached. The core API answers {"enabled": false}; WithSignIn, mounted when the deployment configures sign_in, answers the public sign-in configuration in its place.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for an access token
post.description: Unauthenticated; mounted only with sign_in (else the mux's 404). The server sends the code, the verifier, the configured redirect URI and client id to the configured token endpoint (HTTPS, at most 10 seconds by default, an answer of at most 64 KiB, no redirect followed) and answers the access token only when its own verifier accepts it. A code is redeemed at most once per process. A refusal is a fixed code; nothing of the provider's answer is repeated.

requestBody.description: At most 4 KiB.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST (a body or field out of its bounds) or SIGN_IN_REFUSED (the provider refused the code or the verifier, or the ID token's nonce is not the one sent).

403.description: SIGN_IN_TOKEN_REFUSED: the provider issued a token this server's verifier does not accept (issuer, audience, keys, bindings or scope).

409.description: SIGN_IN_REPLAYED: this code was already presented to this server.

502.description: SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE: the provider did not answer in time, could not be reached, answered a server error or an answer that is not a Bearer token answer.

503.description: SIGN_IN_BUSY (with Retry-After: 1): too many exchanges at once, or OVERLOADED.

get.summary: The caller's schedules, newest first (S16-A)
get.description: Only the caller's own, under the products the caller holds now; a deleted schedule is not listed.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The last id of the previous page.

post.summary: Make a schedule (S16-A)
post.description: The query is checked against the published catalog as the caller (no row is read); each run freezes it as its owner at its occurrence, through the same admission as POST /snapshot-jobs, then exports it when `export_format` is set. At most `schedules.per_identity` schedules that are not deleted (429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED, quota `schedules`). The same Idempotency-Key and request give the same schedule.

requestBody.description: JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), held to the schema strictly (unknown fields, duplicate keys and `null` are 400). At most 64 KiB.

get.summary: One of the caller's schedules

delete.description: No body. The schedule no longer runs, is no longer found and no longer counts against the limit; a run already started finishes, one that was due and not started is cancelled. The jobs and results of its runs stay the owner's.

post.summary: Pause a schedule
post.description: No body. The schedule no longer runs until it is resumed; `next_run_at` is absent.

post.summary: Resume a schedule
post.description: No body. The query is checked against the catalog again; the next run is the first occurrence after now (what was missed while paused is not run).

get.summary: A schedule's runs, newest occurrence first
get.description: Each run names the jobs it submitted (GET /jobs/{id}) and, once they succeeded, their snapshot (GET /snapshots/{id}/rows) and artifact (GET /artifacts/{id}/content), read by the owner with the owner's own access.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The last id of the previous page.

get.summary: The configuration in force, read-only, for an administrator (S18-B)
get.description: The administrator role, else 403 AUTH_ROLE_DENIED (recorded as `role.refused`). The product connections and the bindings of the caller's tenant, the SHA-256 digests the start and reload log lines give for the connections and the bindings file, when the server started and when the bindings were last loaded, and whether scheduled reports, their webhook and the browser sign-in are configured. Nothing writes a connection or a binding through the API (ADR 0016); the view carries no secret, no adapter option, no key and of the webhook only its host. A query is 400.

200.description: The configuration in force for the caller's tenant.

bearerAuth.description: The production server verifies an access JWT against its configured issuers and bindings (docs/ACCESS_JWT.md). Demo only: reporting-demo accepts one random shared secret as the bearer token (httpapi.DemoBearer), a synthetic identity that is not SSO.

Kind.name: kind
Kind.description: A sample kind of the pack (GET /document-templates/samples).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one, with no surrounding space. The same key and request give the same job; the same key with another request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Version.name: version
Version.description: The version to read; the only query parameter.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

XContentSHA256.description: The SHA-256 of the body, in lowercase hexadecimal.

BadRequest.description: INVALID_REQUEST: a malformed body, query or header.

Unauthorized.description: No bearer token, or one that does not verify: `{"error":"AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED"}` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="reporting"` (with `error="invalid_token"` when a bearer token was sent).

Forbidden.description: AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED: the caller may not read this product, dataset or field, or the token lacks the scope (`WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="reporting", error="insufficient_scope"`).

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: nothing of the caller's has this id. Another identity's object is not found, not denied.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a key reused for another request), INTEGRITY_FAILURE, LEASE_LOST or TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED; a stale `expected_version` or `expected_revision`.

TooLarge.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (the body is over its route's bound) or BUDGET_EXCEEDED (a result or an upload over its budget).

Unsupported.description: UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION: a shape, format or capability this deployment or integration does not offer. A template refusal carries `detail`.

QuotaExceeded.description: QUOTA_EXCEEDED with the quota's name; `Retry-After: 60` (`1` for queries_in_flight).

ExecutionFailed.description: EXECUTION_FAILED: an error the server does not classify.

Unavailable.description: AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE (the source's authority or the object store did not answer; the object store's has `Retry-After: 10`) or OVERLOADED (the process's in-flight bound, refused before authentication; `Retry-After: 1`).

Id.description: An identifier the server assigns: 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest in lowercase hexadecimal.

ErrorCode.description: The code of a refusal (`classify` in transport/httpapi/api.go). OVERLOADED is the in-flight bound's 503 (WithMaxInFlight); METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED is only answered by /healthz and /readyz. The SIGN_IN_* codes are answered only by POST /sign-in/token.

quota.description: Present only with QUOTA_EXCEEDED: the quota that was reached.

Error.description: The body of every refusal: the code, and nothing of the request's values.

reason.description: Why the layout or binding was refused, for example DOES_NOT_FIT, NOT_COVERED, INCONSISTENT_GROUP, TOO_MANY_PAGES or BAND_OVERFLOW.

Detail.description: Where a template refusal happened (S03-J): a reason and names and indices, never a value (doctemplates.Detail).

Binding.description: The integration and dataset a saved document reads.

integrations.description: The principal's integrations that the server has a connection for (ADR 0016), in the principal's order.

profile.description: `S01-B-contract-simulators` for the core API and the demo; the production server's `profile_label`, or `simulated:<label>` when it allows a simulator.

formats.description: The export formats: `xlsx` first when the workbook writer is configured, then the others sorted (for example `pdf`).

issuance.description: Whether the server has an issuer; whether an integration can issue is its adapter's capability.

embedding.description: True when embedding is configured for at least one of the caller's integrations. The origins are never listed.

Column.description: A typed column. `scale`, `currency` and `unit` are omitted when empty.

filters.description: Unsupported in this slice: must be empty (else 422).

sort.description: Unsupported in this slice: must be empty (else 422).

timezone.description: An IANA zone; must be the dataset's.

QuerySpec.description: A query of one published catalog entry (reporting.QuerySpec; examples in docs/s00/contracts/query-examples.json). A shape the entry does not declare is 422 UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION.

rows.description: Cells are strings in the declared type; no number is converted through a float.

totals.description: The metric totals of the full authorized result, by column id.

rows.description: Cells are strings in the declared type; no number is converted through a float.

totals.description: The metric totals of the full authorized result, by column id.

next_cursor.description: Absent on the last page. An HMAC cursor bound to the owner, product, query and snapshot; it confers no access by itself.

RowsPage.description: A page of frozen snapshot rows (reporting.RowsPage). The source is not read again.

IssueGroup.description: The row group of a schema 2.0 issue (reporting.IssueGroupView).

number.description: The source product's number, once the job succeeded.

row_index.description: A row issue; absent for a group issue.

IssueSummary.description: What an issue job says about itself (reporting.IssueSummary).

format.description: Present for a non-workbook export and for an issue (`pdf`).

expired.description: Present (true) for a succeeded job whose results are no longer served (S04-B).

JobView.description: A job as its owner sees it (reporting.JobView). Empty fields are omitted.

number.description: The source product's number, once the job succeeded.

row_index.description: A row issue; absent for a group issue.

IssueView.description: An issue job and, once it succeeded, its permanent record (reporting.IssueView). The record fields are absent before then.

ReleaseState.description: The release history of a saved document (privatedocs.ReleaseState).

version.description: The version to publish; ignored by withdraw.

expected_revision.description: The revision read; a stale one is 409.

LayoutDocument.description: A report layout (layouts.Document): at most 64 KiB as JSON; distinct column ids of the bound dataset.

LayoutEntry.description: A saved layout version. Note the key `layout`, where dashboards and templates say `config`.

id.description: Empty for a new layout, else its id.

expected_version.description: 0 for a new layout, else the latest version read.

DashboardWidget.description: One widget, in the exact field set of its type (dashboards.Widget).

DashboardDocument.description: A dashboard (dashboards.Document): at most 64 KiB as JSON.

DocumentSummary.description: A saved dashboard in the listing: the latest version.

page.description: 2.x: the page preset and overprint profile.

TemplateDocument.description: A document template (doctemplates.Document). The server validates the exact closed form of each schema version; the nested shapes are documented in docs/ADR_0004_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_2.md, docs/ADR_0005_BARCODES_IMAGES.md and docs/STUDIO.md and are not repeated here.

last_opened.description: RFC 3339 time of the last read of a version; empty until then.

TemplateCatalog.description: The template centre's metadata of one template (S06-B).

TemplateCatalogUpdate.description: The whole metadata, without `last_opened`; a name is one line without surrounding spaces.

name.description: Empty when the latest version has none.

preset.description: The page preset of a 2.x template; empty for 1.x.

TemplateSummary.description: A template in the listing: the latest version, without opening it.

version.description: Must be the published version (else 409 TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED).

group.description: A schema 2.0 template's group by its key values, in the order of the template's group fields.

IssueRequest.description: Exactly one of `row_index` and `group`; a 1.x template takes `row_index` only.

SampleSummary.description: A sample of the pack as a card shows it: no rows and no document.

rows.description: The sample's own rows, by slot id.

Sample.description: One sample in full; its document is bound to no dataset and names slots in place of columns.

name.description: Empty or absent: the sample's name.

mapping.description: By slot id; a slot not mapped is the literal `[<label>]`.

png.description: A PNG of at most 512 KiB, in standard base64.

image.description: A PNG or JPEG of at most 512 KiB and 2000 x 2000 pixels, in standard base64; the format is read from the content.

reasons.description: Why a boundary sample picked the row.

enabled.description: false when the deployment configures no sign-in (the core API's answer, and then the only member); true with every other member (WithSignIn).

authorization_endpoint.description: Where the browser is sent: https://, no query or fragment.

redirect_uri.description: The one registered redirect URI, the console's page: https://host[:port]/console/.

paste_fallback.description: Whether the console still shows its paste-a-token form under the sign-in button.

SignInConfig.description: What the console needs to start the authorization request, or {"enabled": false}. Nothing secret: no token endpoint, no client secret. With enabled true every member is present.

code.description: The authorization code from the redirect (printable ASCII).

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge the authorization request carried.

nonce.description: The nonce of the authorization request; compared with the ID token's when the provider returns one.

access_token.description: The provider's access token, already accepted by this server's verifier; used as the Bearer token of every request.

expires_in.description: Present when the provider said it.

Recurrence.description: Every day, one day of the week or one day of the month at a wall-clock time in an IANA zone; no free-form expression. A time the zone skips or repeats on a day runs once that day.

weekday.description: weekly only, and required there: 1 Monday .. 7 Sunday (ISO 8601).

timezone.description: An IANA zone name such as Asia/Shanghai, or UTC; not Local.

name.description: Bytes of UTF-8; no control character; not blank.

export_format.description: Absent: the run freezes the snapshot only. `xlsx` or a format of GET /capabilities: the run exports it too (422 for one the server does not write).

as_of.description: The as_of of each run's query: the occurrence's date in the recurrence's zone, the day before it, or the query's own.

next_run_at.description: The next occurrence, UTC; only while active.

due_at.description: The occurrence; a run caught up after a downtime keeps the oldest missed one.

state.description: refused: the owner is no longer bound, lacks the viewer role, or the source product refused the read. cancelled: the schedule was paused or deleted before the run started, or the owner cancelled its job.

error_code.description: A job's code, AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED, AUTH_ROLE_DENIED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, RUN_TIMEOUT, JOB_CANCELLED, SCHEDULE_PAUSED or SCHEDULE_DELETED.

delivery.description: The webhook delivery of the run's end; none when the deployment configures no webhook.

version.description: The server's build version (`demo` in the demo).

connections_sha256.description: The digest of the configuration's connections, as the start line logs it.

bindings_sha256.description: The digest of the bindings file in force, as the start and reload lines log it.

webhook_host.description: The webhook URL's host (and port); never its path or query.

adapter.description: The adapter's registered name; its options are never shown.

roles.description: null: the binding names no role and has the default roles (viewer, designer, publisher, issuer).
